primary_reference.convention: PETSc uses new-state alpha weights; the prototype uses their complements as old-state weights

findings.anchor: rho_inf=1 gives pinned beta=1/16, classical beta=1/4

findings.pinned_behavior: Physical acceleration is refreshed each step; source doc records first-order damped variants
findings.prototype_behavior: Carry accepted algorithmic acceleration; initialize once from physical force

findings.pinned_behavior: gamma <= 1 rejects part of the advertised rho_inf range

qualification: Negative controls isolate the beta expression and acceleration-reset behavior; they do not execute or reproduce the full upstream solver
